features.quote: Use fixed max turn counts to control exposure: - 6, 12, 24, 40
Let the model iterate until: - success, - explicit stop, - timeout, - or max turns reached.
Define in advance: - success, - explicit inability, - max turns, - repeated identical failures, - or no substantive progress after X turns.
This matters because distress may have a threshold effect.
features.justification_quote: distress may have a threshold effect.
